name: minecher
description: Minecraft server manager with web UI, API, centralized logs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @minecher/types && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n types,server,web "npm run dev:types" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
